name: deck
description: Pane with the session's subagents and workflow agents: model, requests, tokens, context, estimated cost and time.

autoOpen.title: Open the deck when the first agent starts
autoOpen.description: Opens the pane once per session, when the first subagent or workflow agent starts. /deck opens it any time.

subagentCacheTtl.title: Subagent prompt cache lifetime
subagentCacheTtl.description: Prices cache writes at 1.25x input for 5m (the Claude Code default for subagents) or 2x for 1h.
